description.zh:
是否启用访问日志采集，取值：

- `true`：启用访问日志采集。

- `false`：不启用访问日志采集。

默认值：`false`。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable access log collection. Valid values:

- `true`: enables access log collection.

- `false`: disables access log collection.

Default value: `false`.

description.zh:
开启和关闭访问日志，取值：

- `“”`：关闭访问日志。

- `/dev/stdout`：开启访问日志。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable access logs. Valid values:

- `""`: disables access logs.

- `/dev/stdout`: enables access logs.

description.zh: 自定义访问日志的格式（需先启用访问日志，否则自动忽略本项）。本项字符串为JSON格式，且JSON字符串中必须至少包含以下键值：authority\_for、bytes\_received、bytes\_sent、downstream\_local\_address、downstream\_remote\_address、duration、istio\_policy\_status、method、path、protocol、requested\_server\_name、response\_code、response\_flags、route\_name、start\_time、trace\_id、upstream\_cluster、upstream\_host、upstream\_local\_address、upstream\_service\_time、upstream\_transport\_failure\_reason、user\_agent、x\_forwarded\_for。
description.en: The custom format of access logs. This parameter is ignored if access log collection is disabled. The value must be a JSON string. The JSON string must contain the following keys: authority\_for, bytes\_received, bytes\_sent, downstream\_local\_address, downstream\_remote\_address, duration, istio\_policy\_status, method, path, protocol, requested\_server\_name, response\_code, response\_flags, route\_name, start\_time, trace\_id, upstream\_cluster, upstream\_host, upstream\_local\_address, upstream\_service\_time, upstream\_transport\_failure\_reason, user\_agent, and x\_forwarded\_for.

description.zh: 是否启用将ASM网关访问日志采集到阿里云日志服务SLS。
description.en: Specifies whether to collect the access logs of the ASM gateway to Simple Log Service.

description.zh: 采集到SLS的入口网关访问日志的存储周期（天）。例如`30`代表30天。
description.en: The retention period of the access logs of the ingress gateway that are collected in SLS. Unit: days. For example, `30` indicates 30 days.

description.zh: 自定义日志服务SLS采集的Project。
description.en: The custom SLS project to which access logs are collected.

description.zh:
是否启用Envoy的gRPC日志服务，取值：

- `true`：启用Envoy的gRPC日志服务（ALS）。

- `false`：不启用Envoy的gRPC日志服务（ALS）。

默认值：`false`。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the gRPC Access Log Service (ALS) of Envoy. Valid values:

- `true`: enables the gRPC ALS of Envoy.

- `false`: disables the gRPC ALS of Envoy.

Default value: `false`.

description.zh: 启用Envoy的gRPC日志服务（ALS）的地址。
description.en: The endpoint of the gRPC ALS of Envoy.

description.zh: 启用Envoy的gRPC日志服务（ALS）的端口。
description.en: The port of the gRPC ALS of Envoy.

description.zh: 是否启用将ASM网格代理（Sidecar）的日志采集到阿里云日志服务SLS。
description.en: Specifies whether to collect the access logs of the sidecar proxy to Simple Log Service.

description.zh: 采集到SLS的Sidecar访问日志的存储周期（天）。例如`30`代表30天。
description.en: The retention period of the access logs of the sidecar proxy that are collected in SLS. Unit: days. For example, `30` indicates 30 days.

description.zh:
网格审计对应的日志项目名称。

默认值：`mesh-log-{meshId}`。
description.en:
The SLS project that is used for mesh audit.

Default value: `mesh-log-{meshId}`.

description.zh:
是否开启通过Pod Annotations实现自动注入Sidecar，取值：


- `true`：开启通过Pod Annotations实现自动注入Sidecar。

- `false`：不开启通过Pod Annotations实现自动注入Sidecar。

默认值：`false`。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic sidecar proxy injection using pod annotations. Valid values:

- `true`: enables automatic sidecar proxy injection using pod annotations.

- `false`: disables automatic sidecar proxy injection using pod annotations.

Default value: `false`.

description.zh: 设置是否启用数据面集群Kubernetes API访问Istio资源（需ASM实例v1.9.7.93版本以上）。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable data plane clusters to access Istio resources using the Kubernetes API. This feature is available only for ASM instances of v1.9.7.93 or later.

description.zh: 从CaCert到RootCert的证书链，至少包含两个证书。
description.en: The certificate chain from the CA certificate to the root certificate. The certificate chain must contain at least two certificates.

description.zh:
服务网格实例规格，取值：

- `standard`：标准版。

- `enterprise`：企业版。

- `ultimate`：旗舰版。
description.en:
The instance type of the service mesh. Valid values:

- `standard`: Standard Edition.

- `enterprise`: Enterprise Edition.

- `ultimate`: Ultimate Edition.

description.zh:
是否启用CNI，取值：

- `true`：启用CNI。

- `false`：不启用CNI。

默认值：`false`。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable Container Network Interface (CNI). Valid values:

- `true`: enables CNI.

- `false`: disables CNI.

Default value: `false`.

description.zh: CNI排除的命名空间。
description.en: The namespaces that are excluded from CNI.

description.zh: 设置数据面Sidecar代理的并行度。
description.en: The degree of parallelism for the sidecar proxy on the data plane.

description.zh:
是否启用外部服务注册中心，取值：

- `true`：启用外部服务注册中心。

- `false`：不启用外部服务注册中心。

默认值：`false`。
description.en:
Specifies whether to use an external service registry. Valid values:

- `true`: uses an external service registry.

- `false`: does not use an external service registry.

Default value: `false`.

description.zh: Nacos注册中心实例ID。
description.en: The ID of the Nacos instance.

description.zh:
是否自定义Prometheus，取值：

- `true`：自定义Prometheus。

- `false`：不自定义Prometheus。

默认值：`false`。
description.en:
Specifies whether to use a self-managed Prometheus instance. Valid values:

- `true`: uses a self-managed Prometheus instance.

- `false`: does not use a self-managed Prometheus instance.

Default value: `false`.

description.zh:
是否启用自建Zipkin，取值：


- `true`：启用自建Zipkin。

- `false`：不启用自建Zipkin。

默认值：`false`。
description.en:
Specifies whether to use a self-managed Zipkin system. Valid values:

- `true`: uses a self-managed Zipkin system.

- `false`: does not use a self-managed Zipkin system.

Default value: `false`.

description.zh:
是否启用DNS Proxying，取值：

- `true`：启用DNS Proxying。

- `false`：不启用DNS Proxying。

默认值：`false`。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable DNS proxying. Valid values:

- `true`: enables DNS proxying.

- `false`: disables DNS proxying.

Default value: `false`.

description.zh:
ASM下发到数据面组件的默认调度配置。支持以JSON的形式配置`nodeSelector`和`tolerations`。

> - 该参数的修改属于高危操作。该操作会导致ASM所有的数据面组件重启，请谨慎操作。
>- 此处配置不包括ASM网关，网关调度请在网关中配置。
description.en:
The default scheduling configurations that ASM delivers to the data plane components. You can configure `nodeSelector` and `tolerations` in the JSON format.

> - Modifying this parameter is a high-risk operation. This operation restarts all data plane components in the ASM instance. Proceed with caution.
>
> - These configurations do not apply to ASM gateways. To configure scheduling for an ASM gateway, specify the scheduling configurations in the gateway settings.

description.zh: 用于选择性服务发现的数据平面命名空间标签选择器列表。
description.en: The label selectors for the namespaces of the data plane. The selectors are used for selective service discovery.

description.zh:
是否启用DubboFilter，取值：

- `true`：启用DubboFilter。

- `false`：不启用DubboFilter。

默认值：`false`。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the Dubbo filter. Valid values:

- `true`: enables the Dubbo filter.

- `false`: disables the Dubbo filter.

Default value: `false`.

description.zh:
是否启用网格审计（需要开通[阿里云日志服务](https://sls.console.aliyun.com/)），取值：

- `true`：启用网格审计。

- `false`：不启用网格审计。

默认值：`false`。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable mesh audit. To enable this feature, you must activate [Simple Log Service](https://sls.console.aliyun.com/). Valid values:

- `true`: enables mesh audit.

- `false`: disables mesh audit.

Default value: `false`.

description.zh: 是否启用网格自动诊断功能（开启后，当修改网格内Istio资源时，将会自动对网格进行诊断）。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable automatic diagnostics for the service mesh. If you enable this feature, the service mesh is automatically diagnosed when you modify an Istio resource in the service mesh.

description.zh: 设定是否令Sidecar代理在启动前加载bootstrap配置
description.en: Specifies whether to load the bootstrap configurations before the sidecar proxy starts.

description.zh: 设置是否启用ASM的Istio资源历史版本管理功能。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable the history revision management feature for Istio resources in Service Mesh (ASM).

description.zh:
是否为所有命名空间开启自动注入功能，取值：

- `true`：为所有命名空间开启自动注入功能。

- `false`：不为所有命名空间开启自动注入功能。

默认值：`false`。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic sidecar proxy injection for all namespaces. Valid values:

- `true`: enables automatic sidecar proxy injection for all namespaces.

- `false`: disables automatic sidecar proxy injection for all namespaces.

Default value: `false`.

description.zh:
是否启用SDS服务，取值：

- `true`：启用SDS服务。

- `false`：不启用SDS服务。

默认值：`false`。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the Secret Discovery Service (SDS). Valid values:

- `true`: enables the SDS.

- `false`: disables the SDS.

Default value: `false`.

description.zh: 排除拦截对外访问的地址范围。
description.en: The IP address ranges for which outbound traffic is not intercepted.

description.zh: 以英文半角逗号（,）分隔的入站端口列表。
description.en: A comma-separated list of inbound ports that are excluded from redirection.

description.zh: 以英文半角逗号（,）分隔的出站端口列表。
description.en: A comma-separated list of outbound ports that are excluded from redirection.

description.zh: 新的CaCert。仅当创建网格时使用了自定义证书时才可以修改该参数。
description.en: The new CA certificate. You can modify this parameter only if you used a custom certificate when you created the service mesh.

description.zh: 新的CaKey。仅当创建网格时使用了自定义证书时才可以修改该参数。
description.en: The new CA key. You can modify this parameter only if you used a custom certificate when you created the service mesh.

description.zh: 新的RootCert。仅当创建网格时使用了自定义证书时才可以修改该参数。
description.en: The new root certificate. You can modify this parameter only if you used a custom certificate when you created the service mesh.

description.zh:
是否启用Gateway配置过滤，取值：

- `true`：启用Gateway配置过滤。

- `false`：不启用Gateway配置过滤。

默认值：`false`。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable gateway configuration filtering. Valid values:

- `true`: enables gateway configuration filtering.

- `false`: disables gateway configuration filtering.

Default value: `false`.

description.zh:
是否启用Gateway API，取值：

- `true`：启用Gateway API。

- `false`：不启用Gateway API。

默认值：`false`。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable Gateway API. Valid values:

- `true`: enables Gateway API.

- `false`: disables Gateway API.

Default value: `false`.

description.zh: 设置在Pod启动时是否先等待Sidecar代理容器启动再启动业务容器。
description.en: Specifies whether to wait for the sidecar proxy container to start before the application container starts when a pod is being started.

description.zh:
是否支持HTTP1.0，取值：


- `true`：支持HTTP1.0。

- `false`：不支持HTTP1.0。

默认值：`false`。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable support for HTTP 1.0. Valid values:

- `true`: enables support for HTTP 1.0.

- `false`: disables support for HTTP 1.0.

Default value: `false`.

description.zh: 拦截对外访问的地址范围。
description.en: The IP address ranges for which outbound traffic is intercepted.

description.zh: 设置端口使Inbound流量经过Sidecar。
description.en: The inbound ports for which traffic is redirected to the sidecar proxy.

description.zh: 设置端口使outbound流量经过Sidecar。
description.en: The outbound ports for which traffic is redirected to the sidecar proxy.

description.zh: 是否为访问ASM网格拓扑创建CLB。
description.en: Specifies whether to create a Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance for accessing the ASM mesh topology.

description.zh:
Sidecar对入向流量的拦截策略。取值：
- `REDIRECT`：默认的拦截策略，Sidecar将使用重定向方式拦截入向流量。
- `TPROXY`：透明代理拦截策略，Sidecar将以透明代理的方式拦截入向流量。
description.en:
The mode of inbound traffic interception by the sidecar proxy. Valid values:

- `REDIRECT`: the default interception mode. The sidecar proxy intercepts inbound traffic using redirection.

- `TPROXY`: the transparent proxy mode. The sidecar proxy intercepts inbound traffic using a transparent proxy.

description.zh:
当启用网格拓扑功能且集成ARMS Prometheus采集监控指标时，若ARMS Prometheus实例配置了鉴权token，通过此参数设定ARMS Prometheus的鉴权Token，以授权网格拓扑访问ARMS Prometheus实例。
参数格式为JSON编码的字符串，JSON对象中的键为数据面集群的集群ID，值为数据面集群内安装的ARMS Prometheus实例设定的鉴权Token。
description.en:
If you enable the mesh topology feature and use ARMS Prometheus to collect metrics, and the ARMS Prometheus instance has a token-based authentication configuration, you can use this parameter to specify the authentication token. This authorizes the mesh topology to access the ARMS Prometheus instance.
The value is a JSON-encoded string. The key in the JSON object is the ID of the data plane cluster, and the value is the authentication token of the ARMS Prometheus instance that is installed in the data plane cluster.

description.zh:
是否启用网格拓扑（需先开启采集Prometheus监控指标，当该项更新为`false`时，本项强制为`false`），取值：

- `true`：启用网格拓扑。

- `false`：不启用网格拓扑。

默认值：`false`。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the mesh topology feature. To enable this feature, you must first enable Prometheus to collect metrics. If you disable Prometheus to collect metrics, this feature is forcibly disabled. Valid values:

- `true`: enables the mesh topology feature.

- `false`: disables the mesh topology feature.

Default value: `false`.

description.zh:
当开启网格拓扑且为访问网格拓扑创建CLB时，通过此参数使用Annotation配置不同集群中网格拓扑服务的CLB。

参数格式为JSON编码的字符串，JSON对象中的键为数据面集群的集群ID，值为数据面集群中网格拓扑服务的Annotation内容。

有关如何通过注解配置CLB，请参考<props="china"> [通过Annotation配置传统型负载均衡CLB](https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86531.html)</props><props="intl">[通过Annotation配置传统型负载均衡CLB](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/container-service-for-kubernetes/latest/use-annotations-to-configure-load-balancing-1)</props>。
description.en:
If you enable the mesh topology feature and create a CLB instance to access the mesh topology, you can use this parameter to configure the CLB instance for the mesh topology service in different clusters using annotations.

The value is a JSON-encoded string. The key in the JSON object is the ID of the data plane cluster, and the value is the annotation of the mesh topology service in the data plane cluster.

For more information about how to configure a CLB instance using annotations, see <props="intl">[Use annotations to configure a Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/container-service-for-kubernetes/latest/use-annotations-to-configure-load-balancing-1)</props>.

description.zh: 隔离工作负载的标签
description.en: The labels of the workloads that are offloaded.

description.zh: istio-proxy生命周期。
description.en: The lifecycle of the istio-proxy container.

description.zh:
是否启用跨地域负载均衡，取值：

- `true`：启用跨地域负载均衡。

- `false`：不启用跨地域负载均衡。

默认值：`false`。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable locality-based load balancing. Valid values:

- `true`: enables locality-based load balancing.

- `false`: disables locality-based load balancing.

Default value: `false`.

description.zh: 设置数据面Sidecar代理的日志级别。日志级别按输出日志信息量从低到高排序依次为`none`、`error`、`warn`、`info`、`debug`。
description.en: The log level of the sidecar proxy on the data plane. The log levels are sorted in ascending order of the log verbosity: `none`, `error`, `warn`, `info`, and `debug`.

description.zh:
是否启用MSE微服务引擎，取值：

- `true`：启用MSE微服务引擎。

- `false`：不启用MSE微服务引擎。

默认值：`false`。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable Microservices Engine (MSE). Valid values:

- `true`: enables MSE.

- `false`: disables MSE.

Default value: `false`.

description.zh: 开启MultiBuffer加速功能。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable the MultiBuffer-based acceleration feature.

description.zh: MultiBuffer的策略拉取延迟，默认为空 。
description.en: The polling delay for the MultiBuffer feature. The default value is empty.

description.zh:
是否启用MysqlFilter，取值：

- `true`：启用MysqlFilter。

- `false`：不启用MysqlFilter。

默认值：`false`。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the MySQL filter. Valid values:

- `true`: enables the MySQL filter.

- `false`: disables the MySQL filter.

Default value: `false`.

description.zh: 是否启用节点特征自动获取能力。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable automatic node feature discovery.

description.zh:
是否在禁用节点特征自动获取能力时，清除节点上的特征相关标签。

此字段仅在禁用节点特征自动获取能力时（即设置`NFDEnabled`为`false`时）需要设置。
description.en:
Specifies whether to remove the feature labels from nodes when you disable automatic node feature discovery.

This parameter is required only when you set `NFDEnabled` to `false`.

description.zh: 负责注入OPA代理的Pod所限制的最大CPU核数。例如`1000m`表示1核CPU。
description.en: The maximum number of CPU cores that are allowed for the pod responsible for OPA proxy injection. For example, `1000m` indicates one CPU core.

description.zh: 负责注入OPA代理的Pod所申请的最少CPU核数。例如`1000m`表示1核CPU。
description.en: The minimum number of CPU cores that are requested by the pod responsible for OPA proxy injection. For example, `1000m` indicates one CPU core.

description.zh: 负责注入OPA代理的Pod所限制的最大内存。例如`1024Mi`表示1024 MB。
description.en: The maximum memory that is allowed for the pod responsible for OPA proxy injection. For example, `1024Mi` indicates 1024 MB.

description.zh: 负责注入OPA代理的Pod所申请的最少内存。例如`50 Mi`表示50 MB。
description.en: The minimum memory that is requested by the pod responsible for OPA proxy injection. For example, `50Mi` indicates 50 MB.

description.zh: OPA代理容器的CPU资源限制。
description.en: The CPU resource limit of the OPA proxy container.

description.zh: OPA代理容器的内存资源限制。
description.en: The memory resource limit of the OPA proxy container.

description.zh:
OPA代理容器日志级别，取值：

- `info`：输出所有信息。

- `debug`：输出调试信息和错误信息。

- `error`：仅输出错误信息。
description.en:
The log level of the OPA proxy container. Valid values:

- `info`: outputs all information.

- `debug`: outputs debugging information and error messages.

- `error`: outputs only error messages.

description.zh: OPA代理容器的CPU资源请求。
description.en: The CPU resource request of the OPA proxy container.

description.zh: OPA代理容器的内存资源请求。
description.en: The memory resource request of the OPA proxy container.

description.zh:
是否启用OPA注入范围控制能力，取值：

- `true`：启用OPA注入范围控制能力。

- `false`：不启用OPA注入范围控制能力。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable OPA injection scope control. Valid values:

- `true`: enables OPA injection scope control.

- `false`: disables OPA injection scope control.

description.zh:
是否启用OPA，取值：

- `true`：启用OPA。

- `false`：不启用OPA。

默认值：`false`。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable OPA. Valid values:

- `true`: enables OPA.

- `false`: disables OPA.

Default value: `false`.

description.zh:
是否集成开放策略代理（OPA）插件，取值：

- `true`：集成开放策略代理（OPA）插件。

- `false`：不集成开放策略代理（OPA）插件。

默认值：`false`。
description.en:
Specifies whether to integrate with the Open Policy Agent (OPA) plug-in. Valid values:

- `true`: integrates with the OPA plug-in.

- `false`: does not integrate with the OPA plug-in.

Default value: `false`.

description.zh:
对外部服务的访问策略，取值：

- `ALLOW_ANY`：允许访问所有外部服务。

- `REGISTRY_ONLY`：只能访问注册到网格内的服务。
description.en:
The policy for accessing external services. Valid values:

- `ALLOW_ANY`: allows access to all external services.

- `REGISTRY_ONLY`: allows access to only the services that are registered with the service mesh.

description.zh: 是否启用HTTP/3支持。
description.en: Specifies whether to enable HTTP/3 support.

description.zh: Prometheus服务地址（非自定义情况下，使用ARMS地址格式）。
description.en: The endpoint of the Prometheus service. If you do not use a self-managed Prometheus instance, use the endpoint of an ARMS Prometheus instance.

description.zh: istio-init初始化容器CPU资源限制。
description.en: The CPU resource limit of the istio-init container.

description.zh: istio-init初始化容器CPU资源所需。
description.en: The CPU resource request of the istio-init container.

description.zh: istio-init初始化容器内存资源限制。
description.en: The memory resource limit of the istio-init container.

description.zh: istio-init初始化容器内存资源所需。
description.en: The memory resource request of the istio-init container.

description.zh: CPU资源限制。
description.en: The CPU resource limit.

description.zh: 内存资源限制。
description.en: The memory resource limit.

description.zh: CPU所需资源。
description.en: The CPU resources required by the proxy.

description.zh: 内存所需资源。
description.en: The memory resources required by the proxy.

description.zh: 设定数据面Sidecar代理额外上报的指标。
description.en: The additional metrics that are reported by the sidecar proxy on the data plane.

description.zh:
是否启用RedisFilter，取值：


- `true`：启用RedisFilter。

- `false`：不启用RedisFilter。
默认值：`false`。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the Redis filter. Valid values:

- `true`: enables the Redis filter.

- `false`: disables the Redis filter.
  Default value: `false`.

description.zh: 是否安装 SMC 加速
description.en: Specifies whether to install SMC acceleration.

description.zh: 服务网格ID。
description.en: The ID of the service mesh.

description.zh: Sidecar注入器Pod的CPU限制资源。
description.en: The CPU resource limit of the sidecar injector pod.

description.zh: Sidecar注入器Pod的内存限制资源。
description.en: The memory resource limit of the sidecar injector pod.

description.zh: Sidecar注入器Pod的CPU请求资源。
description.en: The CPU resource request of the sidecar injector pod.

description.zh: Sidecar注入器Pod的内存请求资源。
description.en: The memory resource request of the sidecar injector pod.

description.zh: 其他自动注入Sidecar的配置（YAML格式）。
description.en: Other configurations for automatic sidecar proxy injection. The value must be in the YAML format.

description.zh:
是否开启采集Prometheus监控指标（建议使用[阿里云Prometheus监控](https://arms.console.aliyun.com/)），取值：

- `true`：开启采集Prometheus监控指标。

- `false`：不开启采集Prometheus监控指标。

默认值：`false`。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable Prometheus to collect metrics. We recommend that you use [Managed Service for Prometheus](https://arms.console.aliyun.com/). Valid values:

- `true`: enables Prometheus to collect metrics.

- `false`: disables Prometheus to collect metrics.

Default value: `false`.

description.zh: istio-proxy终止等待时长，例如5秒，输入为5s。
description.en: The duration for which the istio-proxy container waits for connections to drain before termination. For example, a value of 5s indicates 5 seconds.

description.zh:
是否启用ThriftFilter，取值：

- `true`：启用ThriftFilter。

- `false`：不启用ThriftFilter。

默认值：`false`。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the Thrift filter. Valid values:

- `true`: enables the Thrift filter.

- `false`: disables the Thrift filter.

Default value: `false`.

description.zh: HttpUrl Span标签中包含的请求路径的最大长度，默认值为`256`。
description.en: The maximum length of the URI of the request that is contained in the \`HttpUrl\` span tag. Default value: `256`.

description.zh: 链路追踪采样百分比。
description.en: The sampling percentage for Tracing Analysis.

description.zh:
启用链路追踪（需要开通[可观测链路OpenTelemetry版](https://tracing-analysis.console.aliyun.com/)）。取值：

- `true`：启用链路追踪。

- `false`：不启用链路追踪。

默认值：`false`。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable Tracing Analysis. To enable this feature, you must activate [Managed Service for OpenTelemetry](https://tracing-analysis.console.aliyun.com/). Valid values:

- `true`: enables Tracing Analysis.

- `false`: disables Tracing Analysis.

Default value: `false`.

description.zh: 负载链路追踪导出的代理服务所限制的最大CPU核数。例如`1000m`表示1核CPU。
description.en: The maximum number of CPU cores that are allowed for the proxy service for exporting Tracing Analysis data. For example, `1000m` indicates one CPU core.

description.zh: 负载链路追踪导出的代理服务所限制的最大内存。例如`1Mi`表示1 MB。
description.en: The maximum memory that is allowed for the proxy service for exporting Tracing Analysis data. For example, `1Mi` indicates 1 MB.

description.zh: 负载链路追踪导出的代理服务的副本数量。
description.en: The number of replicas for the proxy service that exports Tracing Analysis data.

description.zh: 负载链路追踪导出的代理服务所申请的最少CPU核数。例如`1000m`表示1核CPU。
description.en: The minimum number of CPU cores that are requested by the proxy service for exporting Tracing Analysis data. For example, `1000m` indicates one CPU core.

description.zh: 负载链路追踪导出的代理服务所申请的最少内存。例如`1Mi`表示1 MB。
description.en: The minimum memory that is requested by the proxy service for exporting Tracing Analysis data. For example, `1Mi` indicates 1 MB.

description.zh:
是否启用WebAssemblyFilter，取值：

- `true`：启用WebAssemblyFilter。

- `false`：不启用WebAssemblyFilter。

默认值：`false`。
description.en:
Specifies whether to enable the WebAssembly filter. Valid values:

- `true`: enables the WebAssembly filter.

- `false`: disables the WebAssembly filter.

Default value: `false`.
